title: In Progress Colony Sim
author: Ball_Analytics
selftext:
Obsidian really puts a lot of things into perspective, granted I'm not even done. I've mostly thrown Opus5/5,5 and Astra at this and currently waiting for my reset at midnight CET to carry on, though I've been creating assets with Astra in that downtime, games in Godot and using Blender for asset generation mostly from images I find on image search for specific things. 

Anyways thought obsdian would put a whole different perspective on my ADRs/APIs, I'll probably share what all this means when I have the game loop figured out.
